text:
maria: Quick ping — draft release notes for 3.8.1 are in the doc: https://gdrive.internal/release-notes/3.8.1. Need a fast copycheck and an internal pin+blast plan. Primary changes: default model bumped v3.2.4 -> v3.2.5, small perf wins, and a fallback path to v3.1.9 if latency regresses. Rollout window suggestion below.
sam: On it. I'll skim for ops-impact and wording. Any specific lines you want to call out to customers?
maria: Callouts: model pin, canary %, rollback criteria. Draft short snippet for internal: ```Internal: Rolling out model v3.2.5 as default for hosted API. Canary 10% for 1h then 30% for 3h. Fallback to v3.1.9 if error rate or tail latency regresses. See full notes in doc.```
carol: Heads-up — several Dedicated customers in the legacy pool need manual coordination for the model bump. I'll DM the account leads the list. :eyes:
tyler: I'll run a quick lint on the draft (microcopy + accessibility). Also — is our deploy window colliding with infra maintenance? We've got a K8s CP upgrade scheduled sometimes this week.
release-ops: Checked infra calendar — control-plane maintenance for us-west-2 is Tue 23:15–23:45 PST. :warning:
sam: That's overlapping with maria's Tue 23:00 suggestion. Can we move? I'd rather not risk controller restarts during canary.
carol: SRE suggested Wed 01:00–02:00 PST as an alternative; keeps the Tuesday maintenance unaffected and avoids peak US hours. +1 from my side. :+1:
maria: OK moving rollout to Wed 01:00 PST. I'll update the notes. Proposed rollout cadence still: canary 10% for 1h -> 30% for 3h -> 100% if stable. Any objections to those percentages?
tyler: 10% then 30% fine. Add explicit rollback triggers in the notes: ```Rollback criteria: 1) >=3% increase in 5xxs from baseline for 10m; 2) p50 latency increase > 2s sustained for 10m; 3) critical customer alert triaged by oncall. If triggered, immediate rollback to v3.1.9 and incident ping to #incidents.```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy ID 4098765432 for 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z (Wed 01:00 PST). Canary policy: 10% for 60m -> 30% for 180m -> 100% rollout. Pin default to v3.2.5. To abort run: `/deploy cancel 4098765432`.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll finish copy edits and add a 2-line TL;DR for the internal blast. Expecting final by EOD today.
maria: Thanks — final checklist I'm doing now: update GDrive, add the rollback criteria (tyler's text), add Dedicated customer callout (carol), schedule internal announcement 2 hours before window, and post the deploy ID in the runbook. If anyone needs to change the schedule, flag here asap.
